limitations: Native512/JS256 rolling limits can omit early starts and route phases; counts are retained-window counts, not whole-session totals.
Resource names/arguments/admitted cache keys, prompt result values and command-complete event identity are redacted. Repeated reads/contexts alone cannot prove duplicate work.
No forced cadence, route/clock alignment or cache hit count is assumed.
Different navigations/windows prevent direct causal HTTP-count or latency-percent comparison with Owner91.
No whole-app load-speed, cold-start SLA, screen paint or frame-rate acceptance follows from transport timings.
A cancelled task (often NSError−999) is distinct from an HTTP/business failure; exact cancellation cause is not reconstructible from neighboring events.
HTTP transport completion does not expose wrapped operation results; business success or writes are not inferred from POST/200 alone.
Physical UI acceptance is supplied separately by the Mac agent.
Descriptive sample percentiles are not long-run SLAs. Same-process report counters are not additive.

snapshotRelationship.interpretation: Per-report counters remain separate. The same process has overlapping JS observations and different native windows with gaps; neither totals nor latency distributions are added or treated as complete session coverage.

sourceSupportedCaveats.httpVsAdmission: Native transport records HTTPend before ensureCurrent/ensureContextCurrent admission checks. A transport200 can be followed by a cancelled context lifecycle. Status1 on contextFailure is NSError.code, not HTTPstatus. Its exact task/epoch/scope guard and specific HTTP are not identified by the exported failure event, which lacks UUID.
sourceSupportedCaveats.routeKeys: Source maps categorylaunch to neutral path / and today to /staff/today; today is a routecategory, not a Staffrole claim. Fresh context joins only identical path keys and may cancel a replaced key; OwnerToday requires compatible Owner private authority. Distinct context paths therefore cannot be classified as same-key duplicates from the observed overlap.
sourceSupportedCaveats.promptPreflight: Original prompt fresh authorization remains. Exact-key preflight may join an existing context flight. contextJoin lacks parent-command UUID, so timing consistency is not proof that a particular join belongs to the prompt.
